name: Quiet Ledger
summary: A technically polished budgeting workspace that makes financial clarity feel calm, credible, and precise. Stripe-inspired structure keeps the playful moments focused on progress rather than decoration.
accentRationale: Deep teal communicates trust and financial stability while feeling fresher and more distinctive for a younger audience than conventional fintech blue.
surfaces: Light posture with a cool neutral-50 page background, neutral-100 navigation and input surfaces, neutral-50 raised content areas with restrained Level 1 shadows, and neutral-200 overlay surfaces for menus and dialogs.
